user.title: Beepbot
user.description: The robot face for your Home Assistant screen. You can change all of this later with Configure. After saving, add the card to a dashboard: see the README.

data.phrases: Understand reminder and alarm requests on this server

data_description.announce: The voice devices (your Echo) that say reminders and alarms out loud.
data_description.wake_lights: Lights that come up slowly before an alarm. Only lights that are off are used.
data_description.lyrics: While music plays, Home Assistant sends the song's title, artist, album and length to lyrics services. The screen itself contacts none.
data_description.lyrics_sources: Open uses LRCLIB only. All adds Better Lyrics, Apple Music lyrics through Paxsenix, and NetEase: more songs word by word, but they are unofficial and could stop working.
data_description.phrases: Copies the reminder, alarm and weather phrases into custom_sentences/en, so these requests are answered here instead of going to a chat assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Beepbot is already set up. Use Configure to change it.
abort.set_in_yaml: Beepbot is set up in configuration.yaml. Change it there, or remove that section and restart to use this page.
